scenes.heading: Track which sources send paying clients

sents.d: Track which sources send paying clients
A source that sends plenty of curious messages can still sign almost nobody.
Friendly messages feel like progress, and they cost you real hours in calls.
Counting inquiries hides that. Counting signed clients shows it.
Add a source field to your client tracker and fill it in for every discovery call.
Once a month, count calls booked and clients signed for each one, then back the winners.

take: Judge a lead source by clients signed, not messages received.
